messages.survival.explore: Walk with [←] [→] or click the papyrus. Click a glowing figure to look; the whole scroll is open to explore.
messages.survival.start: Walk left through the scroll of food, water and breath. Click a figure to look, or open the Journal to read what you have seen.
messages.survival.dwelling: Please claim your rightful seat so you may return to your dwelling.
messages.survival.claimed: The dwelling is his. Should he die, he returns here.
messages.survival.respawn47: He returns to his dwelling. Take back the sceptres from the pylon.
messages.survival.died: His head has fallen. He begins again.
messages.survival.mummy: He comes out of the gate's dark as the man of spell 46. There is no way back.
messages.survival.steady45: He sways in Anubis's hands, wider and wider. Click the sign for "not" fast to steady him.
messages.survival.fell45: The mummy falls and its head comes off. He is back before the gate; going in again costs a sceptre.
messages.survival.upside: He goes headlong. Drag him up to stand upright.
messages.survival.filth: Headlong, he eats filth. A was-sceptre is lost.
messages.survival.water57: Water only dribbles from the goddess's vase. Click it to stand beneath it.
messages.survival.bend: Hold [space] to keep him up with his hands in the water; [esc] leaves.
messages.survival.cover52: Excrement falls. Keep it off the loaves: [←] [→] move his hand over the altar; [esc] gets up.
messages.survival.catch53: Bread and filth fall. Catch the loaves in the cup, never the filth: [←] [→] move his hand; [esc] gets up.
messages.survival.table_lost: The offerings are fouled. A was-sceptre is lost, and the meal begins again.
messages.survival.covered52: The loaves stay clean. He eats no excrement.
messages.survival.heaped53: The altar is heaped with bread. He drinks nothing fetid.
